subject: Procurement & invoice requirements — next steps after call
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acme-industries.com>, accounts-payable@acme-industries.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement & invoice requirements — next steps after call

Hi Diane / AP team,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — good to meet you both. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we need to lock down to get a pilot PO issued: 

- Procurement path: is Acme planning to issue a Purchase Order (PO) for the pilot, or will this go on corporate card? From the call I heard PO likely if total > $10k, but wanted to confirm.
- Marketplace: would you prefer to transact via AWS Marketplace (reduces vendor onboarding) or direct Redwood invoicing?
- Invoice requirements: invoice recipient and billing address, PO number placement, whether you need a PDF invoice + CSV line-item breakdown, and tax/VAT or W-9 requirements.
- Net terms: any standard terms (Net30, Net45, etc.) and who signs off on deviations.
- Vendor onboarding: if you have a vendor form we should complete, please send it; we can also provide our W-9 and certificate of insurance.

I attached a lightweight "Redwood invoice template" (XLSX) that shows the line items we typically send — saves a round trip. If you can confirm PO contact and preferred payment path we’ll prepare the pilot invoice for your review.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm PO vs card and PO contact; 2) we provide vendor paperwork + invoice sample; 3) once procurement confirms, we’ll issue a draft invoice referencing the anticipated PO.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on issuing the invoice until I hear which route you prefer.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (xlsx, 38 KB)

From: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acme-industries.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme-industries.com
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement & invoice requirements — next steps after call

Hi Ben — thanks for the summary, and great to speak yesterday. A few answers from AP/procurement: 

- Procurement path: For pilot purchases under $10k we can do card. For anything over $10k we require a PO. This pilot will likely exceed our $10k internal threshold, so plan on a PO.
- PO process: We issue a PO number once the vendor onboarding and vendor form are complete. Please send your vendor form or let us know if you can sign our standard vendor agreement.
- Invoice format & fields: Invoice must include our PO number (we'll provide once onboarding complete), invoice number, invoice date, line-item detail (description, qty, unit price), and a remit-to address. For electronic submission please send PDF to accounts-payable@acme-industries.com and cc procurement@acme-industries.com.
- Net terms: Standard for Acme is Net30; exceptions require procurement director approval.
- Tax/VAT: We need either a W-9 (US) or VAT registration for EU entities. If you operate in multiple jurisdictions include relevant tax IDs.
- Billing address & remit: 
  Acme Industries, Inc.
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  410 Market St
  Suite 300
  San Francisco, CA 94105

Procurement lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) was flagged as the contact on your side during the call — I'll copy the procurement reviewer once we start onboarding.

We also evaluated Marketplace for other vendors in past — if Redwood can offer AWS Marketplace listing, that may accelerate procurement since legal onboarding is reduced. Happy to discuss that, but for now let's proceed as a direct vendor and get the PO path started.

Diane
Diane Holloway
Director, Procurement — Acme Industries
diane.holloway@acme-industries.com

Attachment: Acme-vendor-onboarding.pdf (stub - vendor form)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, accounts-payable@acme-industries.com
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement & invoice requirements — next steps after call

Hi Diane — perfect, thanks for the clarity.

We’ll plan for the PO path and complete your vendor form. Two quick clarifications: 
1) Can you share the procurement contact who will actually issue the PO (name + email) so we can route paperwork directly?
2) Do you have a preferred PO attachment format? We can submit vendor paperwork + sample invoice as a single PDF bundle to accounts-payable@acme-industries.com.

On Marketplace — noted that could help long-term. If your team wants to explore AWS Marketplace as a future option, we can include that in our notes and open the conversation with our Partnerships team; it often removes the manual onboarding step. For the pilot though, we’ll go direct and expedite the vendor onboarding form.

I’m attaching the invoice template again and will loop Marissa on the vendor paperwork. Once we have the PO contact we’ll complete everything and request PO issuance.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachment: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (xlsx, 38 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acme-industries.com>, accounts-payable@acme-industries.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 10:13:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood billing ops — invoice spec & remit info

Hi Diane / AP team — looping in Redwood billing ops to confirm the simplest route for your PO issuance. Thanks for the call and the clear list, I’ve pasted our standard invoice spec below so your AP team can validate quickly.

Required invoice fields (we will include these by default):
- Redwood invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date
- Your PO number (please include exact PO in subject or top-right of PDF)
- Line items: description, quantity, unit price, extended line total
- Subtotal, itemized tax (if applicable), total due
- Remit-to / billing address and Redwood tax id (EIN)
- Contact for billing questions: billing@redwood.ai

Remit / contact:
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Receivable
123 Willow Ave
San Francisco, CA 94107
Email for e-invoices / PDF delivery: ap@redwood.ai

Net terms: Net30 by default. If Acme needs Net45/Net60 we can escalate to finance for approval — provide the justification when you share your PO.

E-invoicing & marketplaces: We can accept a PDF to ap@redwood.ai or support electronic submission via common procurement portals. If Acme prefers AWS Marketplace to speed up vendor onboarding, we’ll coordinate — but note that subscription billing cadence differs slightly from direct invoicing.

Practical next steps:
1) Ben to send completed vendor onboarding form (requested by Diane).
2) Diane to share PO contact + expected PO issuance date.
3) Redwood to send draft invoice referencing the eventual PO for review.

I attached our vendor onboarding form and the invoice template for AP to review. Let me know if you need the files in PDF only or if we should produce CSV line-item exports for your system.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (pdf, 120 KB); redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (xlsx, 38 KB)
